items.title: Anthropic launches free AI security scans for open-source projects
items.summary: Anthropic's offering to help open-source projects track down security vulnerabilities with a new service called OSS Scanner. items.title: Google’s AI note-taking app transcribes your meetings completely offline
items.summary: Google has released an experimental note-taking app that can transcribe meetings and audio files entirely offline, as reported earlier by TechCrunch. The app, called Google AI Edge Foresight, is free to use and runs on macOS using the company's on-device EmbeddingGemma 2 model.
